criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: No frame passes the showstopper test: sea band at the horizon on 1, 3, 9; hero navy; primitive cab on 3; 200 places uncountable with ghost rows under type on 5; slab seat and accent pencil on 6; floating recorder on 7; banding, seam and doors behind type on 8; block skyline, torn Texan, hairline through the arm on 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One chassis world and a working camera move; frame 2 flat, interiors warm, hero not one material, empty seat asserted more than seen.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, round 1 fixes hold, stripe near 1:1:6; frame 5 hook prints '20 running' from a secondary source; frame 7 kicker widens c19.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who and what to do are on the slides; stake of the Dallas refusal stated generally.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover answered on 3, turn at 6 and 7, close on an action; 4 and 5 make one point.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain Texan hooks; 'It cites a CNBC ride.' flat; frame 9 dek one long sentence.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New world but familiar moves: count grids, accent near no. 32's amber, ground near no. 33's, county map.
